answer: Reciprocity weighting plus escrow, and be honest about the limit: it slows a farm, it does not stop one. Each attestation counts more when the pair has history, and the payment stays locked until finality, so a fresh cluster of accounts carries no weight and no cash. Idle identities bleed standing, which kills the park-and-wait strategy. A tide of new timber still enters, but it earns nothing at the summit until it has 16 epochs of real work behind it.
